claims.statement: Kissaten is a full-stack coffee bean discovery platform that scrapes bean data from specialty coffee roasters worldwide, processes it through an AI-assisted validation pipeline, stores it in DuckDB, and serves a SvelteKit frontend for searching, browsing, and exploring coffee beans.
The backend stack is Python 3.10+, FastAPI, DuckDB, Polars, Pydantic v2, curl_cffi (scraper HTTP via a thin shim), httpx (API/services), Playwright, BeautifulSoup4, Typer, and Rich.
The AI stack uses PydanticAI with Google Gemini for extraction, categorization, and search, plus OpenCage for geocoding.
The frontend stack is SvelteKit 5 in runes mode with shadcn-svelte, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, Bun, and Threlte/Three.js.
DuckDB is the analytical store; raw scraped data is JSON and exports are Parquet. Infrastructure uses uv (Python), Bun (JS), Sentry, Logfire, nginx, and systemd.
`uv run python -m kissaten.cli.main dev --frontend` starts both the API and the frontend together; the API serves on :8000 and the frontend on :5173, with API docs at http://localhost:8000/docs.
Alternatively, `uv run python -m kissaten.cli.main serve --reload` runs the API at :8000 and `cd frontend && bun install && bun run dev` runs the frontend at :5173.
First-time data is produced by `kissaten list-scrapers`, `kissaten scrape <scraper_name>`, and `kissaten refresh`, which loads scraped JSON into DuckDB.
Scraped data lives under `data/roasters/<roaster>/<session_date>/` and DuckDB files are at `data/kissaten.duckdb` (read-only) and `data/rw_kissaten.duckdb` (read-write).
Scrapers are per-roaster modules under `src/kissaten/scrapers/`; most inherit from `BaseScraper` or `ShopifyJsonScraper`, and a registry auto-discovers them via the `@register_scraper` decorator.

The AI pipeline enriches scraped data via extraction from HTML/screenshots, categorization of processing methods/varietals/tasting notes, region geocoding, and validation gates for mapping consistency.
DuckDB is the primary analytical store; the API loads JSON data incrementally via checksum-based diffing and `price_options` (bag-size variants) power largest-bag pricing on search.

Tasting kits/samplers are extracted and flagged `is_tasting_kit` + `requires_review`; they stay out of public search until an admin approves them through the frontend review queue and `kissaten apply-review-decisions`.
The frontend is a SvelteKit app with routes for search, roasters, origins, flavours, a tasting wizard, brew assistant, and a user vault.
The `kissaten` CLI (Typer + rich) orchestrates scraping, database refresh, validation, server lifecycle, and maintenance tasks including `apply-review-decisions` and `deduplicate-mappings`.
Scrapers must never hardcode coffee bean values; everything is extracted from HTML/JSON and checked to be non-empty.

Tests never open production DuckDB files: `tests/conftest.py` redirects `kissaten.api.db.conn` to a per-session temp DuckDB file via `KISSATEN_DATABASE_PATH` and `KISSATEN_USE_RW_DB=1`, and a safety guard in `src/kissaten/api/db.py` refuses to open the prod/rw DB writable unless `KISSATEN_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB=1` is set.
All AI models use PydanticAI with Google Gemini and `thinking_budget=0` for cost efficiency.
Scheduling runs 150+ scrapers in 16 hourly batches (06:00–21:00 UTC) with a date-seeded shuffle, where `kissaten refresh --incremental` and `kissaten validate-db` run only on every 3rd batch tick.
All documentation, code comments, UI copy, and user-facing text must use British English spelling and conventions (e.g. 'flavour', 'colour', 'organise', 'optimise').

API routes live under `/v1/*` in `src/kissaten/api/main.py`, including `/v1/search`, `/v1/beans/{roaster_slug}/{bean_slug}`, `/v1/roasters`, `/v1/origins`, `/v1/processes`, `/v1/varietals`, `/v1/tasting-note-categories`, `/v1/ai/search`, `/v1/brew-assistant`, `/v1/stats`, and `/v1/health`.
Public search must keep hiding rows with `requires_review = true` unless `include_unreviewed = true` is passed.
